allowed_text_changes.before_text:
From this moment forward, you have the ability
to quickly and temporarily reduce discomfort
and sensitivity in a chosen part of your body.

Whenever a new, temporary discomfort or pain
signal arises, and you desire immediate relief,
bring the exact area clearly into your awareness.

Close your eyes and focus your attention
on the part of your body you wish to affect.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Think or say in your mind,
"Plus Go Numb Go Numb."

Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

The discomfort signals from the selected area
will immediately begin to diminish.

Feel the sensitivity decreasing,
becoming less and less,
as the area grows comfortably numb.

The discomfort will quickly fade,
becoming weaker and less important
until it no longer demands your attention.

Your mind will remain clear and alert,
free to concentrate on whatever is needed.

This temporary numbing response
will remain directed toward the
specific area you have chosen.

You will remain aware of your body's needs
and the importance of appropriate care.

Whenever you wish to end the temporary
numbing response, you can do so
quickly and easily.

Bring the selected area into your awareness.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Think or say in your mind, "Plus Release."

Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

The temporary numbing response will end,
and normal sensitivity will return
smoothly and naturally to the selected area.

You remain in complete control,
able to activate or release
this temporary response whenever appropriate.

From this moment forward, this ability
is permanently available to you.

Each time you use Short Fix,
directing and releasing the temporary
response becomes easier, faster,
and more effective.

The function remains ready for conscious
use whenever you need it,
while your body's normal sensitivity
continues at all other times.

entries:
  hplus.function.ocf-bod-015.opener:
    status: reviewed
    version: 1.1.0
    notes: >-
      OCF-adapted opener based on the user-proposed Short Fix
      reconstruction. Proposed input:
      Short Fix/Short_Fix_881039_reconstructed_clean.txt;
      SHA-256 c4c9889958374fa4ea8e8971418c79764cfeb6e841bd3eabd7581bd06b1bc074;
      line 48. Original reconstruction remains unchanged.
      Historical source availability remains unavailable.
      Wording simplified to emphasize rapid, temporary,
      consciously controlled reduction of localized discomfort
      and sensitivity. This is OCF-authored adapted narration,
      not a recovered historical transcript.
      Rights: user_cleared, per user's lawyer-clearance
      attestation. Finished-session release remains pending.
    text: |-
      This OCF exercise will teach you to quickly and
      temporarily reduce discomfort and sensitivity
      in a specific part of your physical body,
      whenever you choose.

  hplus.function.ocf-bod-015.function-body:
    status: reviewed
    version: 1.1.0
    notes: >-
      OCF-adapted narration based on the user-proposed Short Fix
      reconstruction. Proposed input:
      Short Fix/Short_Fix_881039_reconstructed_clean.txt;
      SHA-256 c4c9889958374fa4ea8e8971418c79764cfeb6e841bd3eabd7581bd06b1bc074;
      proposed extent lines 147–211. Original reconstruction
      remains unchanged. Historical source availability remains
      unavailable and reimplementation remains planned.
      The narration has been condensed into targeted awareness,
      temporary numbing, activation, conscious release, and
      lasting availability of the learned function.
      The exact Plus Go Numb Go Numb and Plus Release
      commands are preserved. The original restriction to
      temporary use for new, non-chronic discomfort remains.
      Affirmative suggestions concerning immediate reduction
      of discomfort and restoration of normal sensitivity
      are preserved. The numbing response is not established
      as permanently automatic; conscious control and
      release remain essential. The distinction between
      temporary symptom reduction and treatment of an
      underlying condition is preserved.
      Companion function references are reserved for
      supporting documentation and session configuration.
      One reusable body supports repeated playback across
      Focus 11 and Focus 20.
      Rights: user_cleared, per user's lawyer-clearance
      attestation. Finished-session release remains pending.
    text: |-
      From this moment forward, you have the ability
      to quickly and temporarily reduce discomfort
      and sensitivity in a chosen part of your body.

      Whenever a new, temporary discomfort or pain
      signal arises, and you desire immediate relief,
      bring the exact area clearly into your awareness.

      Close your eyes and focus your attention
      on the part of your body you wish to affect.

      Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

      Think or say in your mind,
      "Plus Go Numb Go Numb."

      Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

      The discomfort signals from the selected area
      will immediately begin to diminish.

      Feel the sensitivity decreasing,
      becoming less and less,
      as the area grows comfortably numb.

      The discomfort will quickly fade,
      becoming weaker and less important
      until it no longer demands your attention.

      Your mind will remain clear and alert,
      free to concentrate on whatever is needed.

      This temporary numbing response
      will remain directed toward the
      specific area you have chosen.

      You will remain aware of your body's needs
      and the importance of appropriate care.

      Whenever you wish to end the temporary
      numbing response, you can do so
      quickly and easily.

      Bring the selected area into your awareness.

      Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

      Think or say in your mind, "Plus Release."

      Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

      The temporary numbing response will end,
      and normal sensitivity will return
      smoothly and naturally to the selected area.

      You remain in complete control,
      able to activate or release
      this temporary response whenever appropriate.

      From this moment forward, this ability
      is permanently available to you.

      Each time you use Short Fix,
      directing and releasing the temporary
      response becomes easier, faster,
      and more effective.

      The function remains ready for conscious
      use whenever you need it,
      while your body's normal sensitivity
      continues at all other times.

  hplus.function.ocf-bod-015.closer:
    status: reviewed
    version: 1.2.0
    notes: >-
      OCF-adapted closer based on the user-proposed Short Fix
      reconstruction. Proposed input:
      Short Fix/Short_Fix_881039_reconstructed_clean.txt;
      SHA-256 c4c9889958374fa4ea8e8971418c79764cfeb6e841bd3eabd7581bd06b1bc074;
      proposed extent lines 332–347. Original reconstruction
      remains unchanged. Historical source availability
      remains unavailable. Closer shortened to one purpose
      reminder, the exact Plus Go Numb Go Numb activation
      command, the separate Plus Release command, and the
      standard OCF ending. Additional reinforcement remains
      in the function body. This is OCF-authored adapted
      narration, not historical transcript wording.
      Rights: user_cleared, per user's lawyer-clearance
      attestation. Finished-session release remains pending.
    text: |-
      Remember, whenever you wish to temporarily
      reduce discomfort in a specific part of your body,
      close your eyes and focus on that area.

      Inhale deeply and hold your breath.

      Think or say in your mind, "Plus Go Numb Go Numb."

      Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

      When you wish to restore normal sensitivity,
      repeat the breathing sequence and think
      or say in your mind, "Plus Release."

      This concludes your OCF Short Fix exercise.

      From this moment forward, you will have greater
      control over your appetite and your desire for food.

      You will recognize the difference between your body's
      genuine need for nourishment and the passing desire
      to eat out of habit, boredom, or impulse.

      Your mind and body will work together in harmony,
      helping you make clear, confident decisions
      about when and what you choose to eat.

      When your body needs nourishment, you will recognize
      that need clearly and respond appropriately.

      When a temporary craving arises and you consciously
      choose not to eat, you will remain calm,
      comfortable, and in complete control of your decision.

      From this moment forward, this awareness
      will become a natural and automatic part
      of your everyday life.

      You will find it easier to recognize when you
      have eaten enough, to enjoy the food you choose,
      and to stop eating when you are comfortably satisfied.

      Your choices will become clearer,
      your habits more intentional,
      and your confidence stronger.

      Whenever you wish to release a passing craving
      or an unnecessary desire for food,
      you can do so quickly and easily.

      Simply pause and bring your awareness
      to the desire you wish to release.

      Take a comfortable breath in
      and gently hold it.

      While holding your breath, silently
      say to yourself, "Plus Satisfied Supplied."

      Then slowly exhale through your mouth,
      as though gently blowing out a candle.

      will become less and less important to you.

      You will feel satisfied with your decision

      toward whatever you choose.

      simply because it is present,

      and release them will operate automatically.

      allowing you to make a clear decision.

      You will feel comfortable and confident
      choosing when to eat and when to wait.

      Each time you use Plus Satisfied Supplied,
      your ability to release unnecessary cravings
      becomes easier, smoother, and more effective.

      Remember, your appetite is something
      you can understand and consciously direct.

      You will recognize your body's needs,
      make your decisions clearly,
      and remain in control of your choices.

      This lasting pattern of awareness,
      satisfaction, and self-control
      will continue strengthening every day.

      Silently say to yourself,
      "Plus Satisfied Supplied."

    status: reviewed

      unverified. Retains canonical Plus Taste More and Plus Taste Less in
      place of proposed GREATER/LESSER terms, with close-eyes-inhale-hold-

      tastes, voluntary reduction of unpleasant or pleasant taste sensations,
      and return to usual taste perception by conscious choice. User-requested
      OCF expansion establishes ongoing inner flavor recall, imagined tasting
      without physical food or drink, and creative modification and combination
      of flavors. The same commands may intensify or soften an imagined flavor
      according to intention; no third command is invented. The learned
      imagery ability is lasting while selected sensory adjustments are
      consciously controlled. One reusable body supports four passes across

      to regulate your sense of taste and develop
      the vividness of flavors within your imagination.

      Your sense of taste will respond to your intention.
      You can notice delicate flavors more clearly,
      or allow unwanted taste sensations to fade.

      To enhance your physical sense of taste,
      close your eyes, inhale deeply, and hold your breath.
      Think or say in your mind, "Plus Taste More."
      Then exhale slowly through your mouth and open your eyes.

      Subtle flavors will become more distinct.
      You will recognize their sweetness, sourness,
      saltiness, bitterness, and savory qualities,
      appreciating their richness and differences.

      To reduce a taste you do not wish to experience
      as strongly, use the same eye and breath sequence,
      thinking or saying, "Plus Taste Less."
      The selected sensation will become less prominent.
      You can soften even an enjoyable flavor when desired,
      and return to your usual sense of taste at will.

      Your inner sense of taste will also grow stronger.
      You will remember familiar flavors and imagine new ones,
      even when no food or drink is present.
      You can bring a flavor into your awareness,
      experience its distinct qualities, and hold it clearly.

      You can imagine combinations of flavors,
      changing their intensity, balance, or character.
      Taste memories will connect more vividly with
      places, experiences, aromas, and inner images.

      This ability to recall and create flavors in your mind
      will become a lasting, natural part of your total self.
      Whenever you choose, your intention and these commands
      can strengthen an imagined flavor or let it gently fade.

      Each time you use this function, physical taste regulation
      and inner flavor imagery will become easier,
      clearer, and more effective.

      user's lawyer-clearance attestation. Finished-session release remains pending.
    text: |-
      Remember, to regulate your sense of taste
      or strengthen your inner experience of flavor,
      close your eyes, inhale deeply, and hold your breath.
      Think or say in your mind, "Plus Taste More"
      or "Plus Taste Less," according to your intention.
      Then exhale slowly through your mouth and open your eyes.

      This concludes your OCF Sensory: Taste exercise.

kept_decisions.purpose: Opens perception of choices and alternatives.
kept_decisions.reason: Close eyes, inhale/hold, select situation, complete cue, exhale with eyes remaining closed. Explore greater-self possibilities/probabilities and consequences while preserving choice. Plus Options is nested only, not independently taught or verified prediction.
kept_decisions.implementation_scope: Keep all current Options wording and metadata unchanged, including actual taught Plus Options Choices. Do not implement the proposed shortening to Plus Options or retire its active legacy alias.
kept_decisions.separate_review_needed: Registry persistence says temporary; narration describes permanently available ability and continuing insights. Keep-current decision does not resolve this distinction.

kept_decisions.purpose: Adjusts appetite and food drive in either direction using the MORE/LESS grammar.
kept_decisions.reason: MORE selects useful food-energy extraction/conversion/distribution/use; LESS selects sufficient nourishment with reduced unnecessary retention/storage. Close eyes, inhale/hold/select complete cue/exhale/open eyes. Neither mode is permanently active; automatic baseline differs. Not appetite control.
kept_decisions.implementation_scope: Keep Nutricia and BOTH current cues unchanged: PLUS-FOOD MORE / Plus Food More and PLUS-FOOD LESS / Plus Food Less. Preserve all existing wording, metadata, distinct operations and active command identities. Do not implement Food Energy Use, Plus Use Food Energy or Plus Retain Less Excess, and do not retire either current cue.
kept_decisions.separate_review_needed: Registry purpose describes appetite and food drive while narration describes food-energy utilization and retention. Keep-current decision does not authorize rewriting purpose or command-role classifications.
